name: 01960 · Peabody, MA
findings: ZIP 01960 (Peabody) has 154 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01960 (Peabody) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01960 (Peabody) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
